properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the ECDSA-secp256k1 signing/keygen layer of the Ethereum dev toolchain (ganache/ethers/web3/ethereumjs) shipped by every subproject's build. The application's own contracts do not verify signatures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the weak single-iteration MD5 KDF rides in with ganache-core/web3's crypto shims in every subproject; recorded because the version pins decide whether a future bump fixes it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 18 sites are package-lock.json entries for the npm bcrypt-pbkdf package (Joyent's port of OpenBSD's bcrypt_pbkdf, a Blowfish-based KDF) and its nested tweetnacl — transitive dependencies of the ganache-core dev toolchain in bounding_curve, contracts-upgradeability-transpiler, governance-with-multisig, initializer_contracts and initializer_contracts_with_args. The KDF ships with every lab project's installed tree; no direct call site in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hardcoded ECDSA-secp256k1 key material in the live Optimism dev-stack compose file: the deployer signs the L1 deployment, the batch-submitter signs L1 batches with the sequencer/proposer keys. Dev-only by design; the pattern must never be copied to production compose files.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-browserify's Node ECDH shim shipped inside the Ethereum toolchain of these four subprojects; present whether or not the application exercises ECDH.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 locked in bounding_curve/package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of the ganache-core/bcrypt-pbkdf hardhat toolchain. tweetnacl provides Ed25519 signatures, X25519 ECDH, XSalsa20-Poly1305 AE and SHA-512; the Ed25519 capability ships with the installed tree though no application code calls it. Ethereum's own tx signing is secp256k1 ECDSA in the toolchain, not tweetnacl.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the ECDSA implementation of the Ethereum toolchain shipped with bounding_curve; the pinned version predates the 2020 invalid-curve hardening (6.5.1+), which is precisely what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl's X25519 capability shipped with the bounding_curve toolchain build.
